soul-shattering-charge.name: Soul-shattering Charge
soul-shattering-charge.short: After a charge, nearby models can fight engaged foes
soul-shattering-charge.description: LEGIONES DAEMONICA MOUNTED unit only. When this unit is selected to fight, if this unit made a charge move this turn, you can use this ability. If you do, when determining which models in this unit can fight, friendly models that are within 3" of enemy units engaged with this unit can target those enemy units.

argath-the-king-of-blades.short: +1 A & S to melee (+2 in Shadow of Chaos)
argath-the-king-of-blades.description: KHORNE LEGIONES DAEMONICA model only. Add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons. While the bearer is within your army's Shadow of Chaos, add 2 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons instead.
